source.rationale: The gate can pass on a raw parser HINT with no uuid behind it. Probing crm_master_product_attachments_list without an attachment_type filter returns every attachment of every type, so a brochure-only product would be labelled 'has certificate'. With no UUID-shaped attachment_type/certificate entity anywhere the node must fail CLOSED: skip reason `no_scoping_entity` and an EMPTY dym_candidate_codes, even though a perfectly good product candidate was available.
